reason: I have run my practice on Excel and WhatsApp groups for ten years without paying for software, so I see no reason to commit ₹12,990 upfront when our spreadsheets work for free. At most, I would only test the free pilot to see if it simplifies my routine before spending a single rupee.
objection: I am a solo CA with one trainee—why should I ever upgrade beyond the free tier?
would_change_my_mind: If testing the free pilot proves dead simple, completely eliminates my two-hour Saturday GST reconciliation, and integrates into our WhatsApp workflow without staff friction.
